name: The Convergence
developmental_beat: The last hostile organism before birth: everything learned — movement, absorption, evolution and energy — must be read and spent in one encounter.
plan_refs: DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md §6 (final stage is playable; birth as culmination)

obstacles.role: spur guarding the organism's approach lane
last membrane; opens once the body is integrated, before the organism is engaged
obstacles.fallback_until_implemented: Use the implemented hide-on-defeat evolution gate pattern from the Rot Bloom arena.

upgrade.name: Final form — integrated body
upgrade.plan_ref: GAME_DESIGN_FOUNDATION.md §7 later game (integration of earlier adaptations)
upgrade.softlock_fallback: The convergence accepts any earlier offensive unlock; integration is a mastery signpost, never a required key.
upgrade.fallback_until_implemented: Use the existing spike burst with the already-learned body; no combo input is invented.
upgrade.note: Birth remains a cinematic and is Open; this upgrade does not implement it.

boss.name: The Convergence
boss.loop: Phase 1 repeats the learned idle 0.4 s → telegraph 0.6 s → attack 0.25 s → exposed 1.5 s rhythm, alternating lash and spore. At 6 of 12 health it enters second_wind: telegraph 0.45 s, exposed 1.1 s.
boss.weak_window: 1.5 s exposed core in phase 1; 1.1 s in second_wind. Body damage is accepted only while exposed.
boss.softlock_fallback: Second wind only shortens timings — it never removes the weak window or adds an untelegraphed kill. Energy regenerates at 1/s; shelter retry resets the boss to 12 and keeps evolution and nutrition.
boss.solution: Read the familiar rhythm, then survive the faster second wind; burst only inside the exposed window. The mother guides but never fights.

narrative.beat: Voice and heartbeat carry the player through the convergence; once it stills, the route to birth opens. Birth itself stays a cinematic, not an implemented sequence, and the mother is never a boss.
